## Mandatory engineering review

- [ ] Every new/modified function is ≤60 lines, nesting is ≤3, and cross-view logic is shared.
- [ ] Photos, evaluations, completion locks and metrics retain canonical engines and receipts; no parallel state caches or DOM shortcuts.
- [ ] Transport/SQL, state/commands and rendering are separate; UI handlers do not query the database.
- [ ] Only live project `kzrnyjsosryejjejliii`; no image transformation endpoint or unguarded polling/realtime refresh.
- [ ] No commented-out executable code, debug statements, dead/unreachable code, unused bindings, orphan helpers or temporary workarounds.

## Verification

Record executed focused checks, negative/safe cases, fast-lock elapsed milliseconds and any unverified behavior. Read `.github/codex-review.md`. Preserve normal hooks; no force or approval/security bypasses.
